def thm_7_1_1 : Prop :=
  ∀ x : ℝ, 10 ^ 8 ≤ x →
    ∀ q : ℕ, 1 ≤ q → q ≤ 300000 →
      ∀ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q, χ.IsPrimitive →
        ∀ δ : ℝ, |δ| ≤ 4 * 300000 / (q : ℝ) →
          ∃ E : ℂ,
            ∑' n : ℕ+, (Λ (n : ℕ) : ℂ) * χ ((n : ℕ) : ZMod q) * e (δ / x * (n : ℕ)) *
                (Real.exp (-((n : ℕ) / x) ^ 2 / 2) : ℂ) =
              (if q = 1 then 1 else 0) * thm_7_1_1_hat thm_7_1_1_etaHeart (-δ) * x + E * x ∧
            ‖E‖ ≤ 4.306e-22 + 1 / √x * (650400 / √(q : ℝ) + 112)

note: Stated in `Companion.Book.thm_7_1_1` with η♡ one-sided, as in §9.2; the file proves that the theorem and the remark after it cannot both hold (`Companion.Book.thm_7_1_1_remark_imp_not`), and that the theorem is false with η♡ two-sided (`Companion.Book.thm_7_1_1_twoSided_false`).
